verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Devin's general task delegation, terminal, browser, API, and MCP capabilities, but nowhere documents an explicit workflow where Devin autonomously writes and executes tests to validate its own code changes prior to proposing them. Community comments even suggest imperfect fixes (e.g., wrapping errors in try-catch) rather than validated, test-driven changes. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automated test generation/execution as a validation step, evidence of a test-and-verify loop before PR/proposal submission.
